milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the oak log tree and face it to demonstrate they have found it. Target is the oak tree trunk center at (3, 2, 3) relative to spawn. Max distance 8 blocks with 60° facing tolerance ensures the player has oriented toward the tree and can see it, without requiring them to walk right up to it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near a red mushroom and face it. Target is the red mushroom at (4, 0, 5) relative to spawn (one of two mushrooms placed near the tree base on mycelium). Max distance 5 blocks with 60° facing tolerance ensures the player has actively looked at the small ground-level mushroom rather than just passing by.

Uses position_near_with_facing because 'interact with' tasks require the player to be close enough to right-click the block and facing it. The brewing stand is at (-3, 1, 4) relative to spawn inside the cobblestone shelter. Max distance 3 blocks (within Minecraft's block interaction range of 4.5) with 60° facing tolerance ensures the player is positioned at the shelter opening and oriented toward the brewing stand, ready to or having just interacted with it.
